up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL2105717 (CABOZANTINIB) and all its salts (including the parent compound) as defined by the molecule_hierarchy table where the parent_molregno corresponds to the molregno of CHEMBL2105717. Use only IC50 activity measurements with standard units in nM against the target CHEMBL3717 (Hepatocyte growth factor receptor). Return the following columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id if available, fall back to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), and target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH parent_molregno AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2105717'
),
hierarchy_molregnos AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy
  WHERE parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM parent_molregno)
),
all_molregnos AS (
  SELECT molregno FROM parent_molregno
  UNION
  SELECT molregno FROM hierarchy_molregnos
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717'
  AND md.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM all_molregnos);
